gloss: to spill; to complain; to let slip

definitions.explanation: To accidentally cause liquid or small items to fall out of a container.

examples.japanese: コーヒーを{零|こぼ}してしまった。
{彼|かれ}はいつも{愚痴|ぐち}を{零|こぼ}している。
{涙|なみだ}を{零|こぼ}しながら{話|はな}した。

notes:
{零|こぼ}す is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) with both literal and figurative meanings.

INTRANSITIVE PAIR: {零|こぼ}れる (to spill, overflow)
- {零|こぼ}す: I spill water.
- {零|こぼ}れる: Water spills.

ASPECT (ている):
{零|こぼ}している can mean currently spilling or habitually complaining.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [liquid]を{零|こぼ}す — to spill [liquid]
- {愚痴|ぐち}を{零|こぼ}す — to complain, grumble
- {涙|なみだ}を{零|こぼ}す — to shed tears

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {水|みず}を{零|こぼ}す (spill water)
- {食|た}べ{物|もの}を{零|こぼ}す (drop food)
- {愚痴|ぐち}を{零|こぼ}す (complain, grumble)
- {弱音|よわね}を{零|こぼ}す (show weakness, complain about hardship)

OFTEN IN HIRAGANA:
Both {零|こぼ}す and こぼす are common. The kanji is the same as "zero" but has this separate native reading.
